answer: A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 16 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes an opal bet on surviving 120 epochs of grading, and every ledge settlement recomputes the river schedule, so an copycat who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 120 epochs rather than arriving at once. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
